names.ja: アスパラガス・プルモーサス
aliases: アスパラガス・セタケウス

light.best.quote: These plants need bright indirect light and high humidity.

light.min.quote: Insufficient light as well as insufficient water will result in yellow needles that drop.

light.min.reason: 出典に暗い場所（Deep shade）への耐性の記載がないため、明るい日陰の一段下までとした

light.directSun.quote: It is intolerant of high light intensity; therefore, avoid direct sunlight.

temperature.minC.quote: when the temperatures drop to near 55 degrees Fahrenheit that will need to be brought back indoors

temperature.idealC.quote: This plant prefers temperatures between 55 to 70 degrees Fahrenheit.

humidity.quote: These plants need bright indirect light and high humidity.

watering.growing.quote: They prefer regular watering in spring to autumn and sparingly in winter.

tips.ja: 光や水が足りないと、細い葉が黄色くなって落ちる。
tips.quote: Insufficient light as well as insufficient water will result in yellow needles that drop.

tips.ja: 水のやりすぎで根腐れする。
tips.quote: Root rot can occur from overwatering.

note: 以前の学名は Asparagus plumosus。
